/suites.title: Support ticket triage
/suites.description: Twenty-four customer messages sent to Fernhill, an invented online invoicing tool. The model labels each one with a category and an urgency and writes a short reply; the checks verify both labels, the 60-word limit, and that the reply never promises money back or asks for a password or card number.
